channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Anthony Bennett | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Anthony Bennett from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Anthony Bennett
item.description:
Lakers GM/PoBo Rob Pelinka on why the Lakers hired Tony Bennett as an NBA Draft Advisor:

“As we refine and build out our NBA draft and scouting processes, we could think of no better basketball mind than Tony Bennett to have as a resource,”

Rob Pelinka on Anthony Bennett, Feb 25, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Gersson Rosas on Anthony Bennett
item.description:
Christopher Hine:Rosas:

“They talk about this as being similar to past drafts, the Anthony Bennett draft for example, but to be fair the reigning MVP was a part of the draft. We have to do our job.”

Gersson Rosas on Anthony Bennett, Aug 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @ChristopherHine.

item.title: Big Sean on Anthony Bennett
item.description:
“We have been excited to watch Anthony's progress this summer with his national team, and look forward to the opportunity of having Kenny and his staff work with him to continue his development,”

Big Sean on Anthony Bennett, Jul 14, 2016. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Jay Triano on Anthony Bennett
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Jay Triano on Bennett:

“Last year he couldn't have practiced like this the whole time, we had to play him in spurts. Today he was very good”

Jay Triano on Anthony Bennett, Jun 15, 2016. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.

item.title: Kyle Lowry on Cory Joseph, Anthony Bennett
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Lowry on Joseph and Bennett:

“They take a lot more media obligations away from us, give it to the Canadians!”

Kyle Lowry on Cory Joseph, Anthony Bennett, Sep 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Kevin Love on Thaddeus Young, Andrew Wiggins, Alexey Shved, Anthony Bennett
item.description:
said Timberwolves owner Glen Taylor.

“On the floor, Kevin has worked hard to make himself a great player in the NBA. He also made it a priority to give back to the community through his Coat Drive and numerous other charitable endeavors. He represented the state of Minnesota well during his time with us and we wish him nothing but the best in Cleveland. I also want to thank Luc and Alexey for their contributions to the team and wish them well in Philadelphia. I am truly excited to welcome Andrew Wiggins, Anthony Bennett and Thaddeus Young to our team. Adding these young players, along with our No. 1 pick from this year, Zach LaVine, to our existing squad gives us a solid nucleus for the future.”

Kevin Love on Thaddeus Young, Andrew Wiggins, Alexey Shved, Anthony Bennett, Aug 23, 2014. Source: NBA.com.
